text.tspan: The cache key must carry the caller's scope.
Keyed on the question alone, it serves one
tenant an answer built from another tenant's documents.
[until goal met or step budget hit]
Per-chunk guards are cheap. Citation coverage needs
the finished text, so it can only run at the end.
[cache hit, same scope, policy version current]

plan and decide if knowledge is needed
prompt plus context plus tool schemas
